finding: Amendment 020 restored model, optimizer, scheduler, and RNG objects, but the replayed step-605 through step-635 metrics did not match the original segment. The cause is dataloader position: 895 accepted prompts with gradient accumulation 4 produce a partial 224th update per uninterrupted epoch, while Transformers' generic resume skip computes floor(895/4)=223 updates per epoch. At checkpoint 600, this shifts the resumed sampler by eight prompts after two epochs.
